request.prompt:
Make a new complete 16:9 mechanical prop reference “北端洞闸·压蛇半落、不能插栓”. IMAGE 1 fixes connected stone body; IMAGE 2 fixes the long round timber; IMAGE 3 fixes the dark broad bands of the snake. FIRST keep the whole stone structure from IMAGE 1: south small barred feeding door, two broad flat covers, continuous low stone sides, north gate, rear covered short segment and rock. Widen blank background only. Raise/extend ONLY THE TOPS of both wooden posts AND the moving wooden panel, giving the upper wooden assembly ample height above the knee-high stone lids.
SECOND remove the original little through-post locking rod completely, including its two protruding round ends. Leave no pegs sticking out of either post. Do NOT draw circular holes on the long beam.
THIRD fix one SHORT horizontal cleat onto the FRONT surface of the MOVING panel, above stone-lid height; both ends stop WELL INSIDE the two posts.
FOURTH add the long grey-brown round beam from IMAGE 2 AGAINST THE FRONT FACE of the cleat. This long beam is CLOSEST TO THE VIEWER, IN FRONT OF BOTH posts. Draw its visible silhouette crossing over and HIDING the middle strips of both posts. At each intersection the LOG HIDES THE POST, NEVER the reverse. The log is uninterrupted from left tip to right tip; it never passes through a post hole.
FIFTH add exactly two short tight rope loops clamping the touching long beam and short cleat together at the moving panel centre, well away from the fixed posts. No hanging rope, no post bindings. Leave a visible gap between log and stone lid. South feeding door retains its FULL horizontal wooden bar. All roofed stone parts and rock remain connected.
Now position the moving panel partially lowered: its bottom rests firmly on the snake body inside the covered passage, not on bottom stone. NO pin is inserted, no side stubs remain. The timber's uninterrupted front surface must visibly OVERLAP both posts, allowing panel, cleat and timber to travel vertically together. A small arrow at each free timber end points DOWN, meaning continuing shoulder pressure.
Show one subtle ghosted window beside the north gate with thin dotted ORIGINAL stone outlines; it reveals the panel pressing the snake body. Small caption “内部示意”. This is an explanatory transparency of intact cover and side, not a new opening. Snake remains entirely inside the north rock/stone passage, not emerging or lying outside. Do not label the south door as a human entrance; it is a barred feeding door.
Clean linework and muted flat paint, pale neutral background. Complete two front lids, rear roofed segment, rock, barred south door and entire beam in one overall image. No figures, gore, extra hardware or gritty texture. Highest native resolution.
